narrative.overview:
The site is the classic minimal engineer page (name, intro, links and plain lists) set on a sheet of warm book paper. The page is quiet on purpose so the words carry it: off-white stock, near-black ink, one clear blue for links with a thin underline, and hairline rules. Nothing sits behind the text. Every structural mark is a 1px line. A title-block rail beside the body says who this is and indexes the sheets.

Density is calm and editorial: generous vertical air measured in units, tight horizontal discipline. The memorable details are structural rather than decorative: the ruled title-block rail, the project schedule, and sheet numbers on every entry. Dark mode is the same book read by lamplight: warm charcoal stock and warm off-white ink. Print drops the rail and keeps the body.

The world deliberately refuses the showy frontend portfolio (hero, cards, motion) and the anonymous white template. It is plain on purpose, but it is set, not default.
keyCharacteristics: One centred 42rem reading column; no multi-column layouts.
A flat, warm paper ground with nothing behind the text.
Structure by 1px rules only: square corners, no shadows, no filled panels except code.
Three voices of type: humanist sans for reading, condensed uppercase for labels, mono for numbers.
One accent (a clear blue) carried only by links, the current nav cell, focus and selection.
No signature motion; only colour and underline transitions.

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Blue is reserved for interaction (links, current location, focus, selection). Static text, rules and labels stay in the warm ink family.

rules.name: The Paper Is the Palette Rule
rules.body: Every neutral is a step of the same warm sheet or its ink. No pure white, no cool grey, no second hue.

rules.name: The Nothing Behind the Words Rule
rules.body: The page ground is a flat colour. No grid, texture, pattern or image sits behind text.

rules.name: The No Display Face Rule
rules.body: Titles are the body family at 700. There is no separate display typeface, and no type larger than 2rem.

rules.name: The Numbers Are Mono Rule
rules.body: Any date, sheet number or count is set in the mono with tabular figures.

rules.name: The Whole-Unit Rule
rules.body: Every width, gap and figure dimension is a whole number of u.

rules.name: The Drawn Not Lifted Rule
rules.body: If something needs separation, rule it. Never lift it with a shadow, blur or overlay.

dos: **Do** measure vertical spacing in units of 1.5rem (u, 2u, 3u, 5u).
**Do** keep every width, gap and figure dimension in whole u.
**Do** separate content with 1px rules: hairline between entries, strong under section heads and around the strip.
**Do** set every date, count and sheet number in the mono with tabular figures.
**Do** mark unconfirmed content with dashed rules and faint ink rather than hiding it.
**Do** give every new colour role a lamp counterpart in both dark-theme blocks.
**Do** keep motion to colour and underline transitions at 160ms on the ease-out curve.
donts: **Don't** add rounded corners, shadows, or soft colour gradients. There are no gradients in the system, and nothing (grid, texture, pattern) behind the text.
**Don't** box list entries into cards or filled panels; filled backgrounds are limited to the header strip's states and code.
**Don't** introduce a display typeface or type larger than 2rem.
**Don't** use blue for anything that is not interactive or the current location.
**Don't** add entrance, scroll or hover motion beyond colour and underline transitions.
**Don't** put a label above a page or post title; labels name fields, sections and sheet positions, never introduce headlines.
